propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as an offline Jira oracle and uses field values for drift classification, but narrowing prev_snapshot to a key-set would silently degrade classification
bridge_fsck.py loads the snapshot file directly (lines 306-308) and passes field values to ObservedJira.PRESENT checks, making it an out-of-band consumer not covered by reconcile_once tests
When prev_snapshot is narrowed to key-set form (jira_key: {}), field-dependent drift classification must report indeterminate rather than inferring from empty dicts to avoid false drift signals
bridge_fsck drift classification against key-set fixtures must be identical to full-payload fixtures for membership-only cases and report indeterminate for field-value-required cases
Full-payload prev_snapshot behavior must remain byte-identical and exit codes / JSON shape unchanged after the fence implementation
The field-dependence fence must distinguish between classification cases that require field values (report indeterminate) and those that need only membership (classify normally)
